<b>Rosaries</b> are the currency of [[Pharloom]] used in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. There are three types of Rosaries that can be found, each with a different value:

| {{R|15}}
|}

== Use ==
Rosaries are used to purchase certain goods, and to activate toll booths to unlock certain [[Bench (Silksong)|Benches]], [[Bellways]], and [[Ventrica]] stations. Certain other machines may also be activated by inserting Rosaries.

Rosaries can be attached to strings, preventing them from being lost upon death. [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] cannot spend the strung Rosaries until the Rosary String is broken.<ref name="e3">[https://youtu.be/Y8lvHT_IQbM?t=480 Hollow Knight: Silksong Gameplay - Nintendo Treehouse: Live | E3 2019]</ref><ref name=edge>[https://pocketmags.com/edge-magazine/february-2021 Edge Magazine February 2021 edition], p. 55.</ref>

* {{R|590}} for all [[Fast Travel (Silksong)#Bellways|Bellways]]
* {{R|480}} for all [[Fast Travel (Silksong)#Ventrica|Ventricas]]
* {{R|510}} for all [[Bench (Silksong)|Benches]]
''{{R|1580}} total''

{{Hr|small}}

=== Infinite Spendings ===
The following can be spent at infinite supply or infinitely until Hornet does certain actions.
* {{R|50}} per [[Shard Bundle]]
* {{R|80}} per [[Rosary String]]
* {{R|140}} per [[Rosary Necklace]] (bought from Frey only)
* {{R|30}} per [[Pilgrim's Rest]] entry and bench use. After the first pay, Hornet can break the mechanism inside the building or wait until it collapses in [[Acts#Act 3: Abyss|Act 3]] to make the entries free.
* {{R|30}} each time [[Flea Brew]] is refilled. In Act 3, Flea Brew is refilled for free.
* {{R|10}} each time Hornet uses [[Kratt]]'s spa service. After the first pay, Hornet can punish Kratt for peeping to use freely.
* {{R|50}} each time [[Plasmium Phial]] is refilled. Eventually it is replaced by [[Plasmium Gland]] which acts as endless reserve.
* {{R|4}} each lost game with [[Lumble the Lucky]]. Eventually Hornet can get all the rosaries back from winning.
* {{R|25}} for each game round organised by [[Loddie]]. Loddie rewards Hornet with [[Tool Pouch]] for first won round, which can be picked up later, and [[Heavy Rosary Necklace]] for second won round. For the third round, Loddie has {{R|380}} in his inventory, which can be depleted or increased by playing. <br><i>Main Article: [[Loddie]]</i>
* {{R|15}} each [[Underworks]] bench use
* {{R|25}} for each confession towards the booth in Underworks' break room
* {{R|10}} to buy a drink from [[Creige]] in [[Greymoor|Halfway Home]]

In addition, the [[Rosary Cannon]] uses Rosaries as ammunition and can be used to load the tool at a bench.

{{Hr|small}}

=== Summary of Costs ===
* {{R|22635}} to get everything at the most sparing prices (excluding Silkshot)
* {{R|23225}} to get everything at maximum prices ({{R|590}} difference, including {{R|240}} for the most expensive Silkshot variant)

== How to Acquire ==
[[File:Rosary pile.png|right|150x150px]]
Rosaries can be acquired in different ways:
* Certain [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] drop Rosaries on death.
** Equipping the [[Thief's Mark]] tool increases Rosary drops, but also causes Hornet to lose 3.5% of her Rosaries whenever she takes damage.
** Equipping the [[Snitch Pick]] makes enemies hit by the [[Clawline]] drop some of their Rosaries before they die, but does not increase how many they can drop in total. 
* Rosaries can be found in containers and artificial structures.
** Destroying Rosary rocks in [[the Marrow]], the [[Far Fields]], [[Greymoor]], [[Bilewater]], and the [[Putrified Ducts]] grants {{R|20}}. Slightly bigger rocks found in [[Bone Bottom]], the Marrow, and the Far Fields grant {{R|25}}. The biggest rocks with visible Shell Rosaries grant {{R|40}} and can be found in Bone Bottom, [[Shellwood]], Bilewater, and the Putrified Ducts.
** Destroying Rosary sacks in the [[Blasted Steps]], Greymoor, [[Sinner's Road]], and Bilewater grants {{R|21}}.
** Emptying Rosary cymbals in Bone Bottom, the Marrow, Greymoor, and [[Mount Fay]] grants {{R|24}}.
** Emptying Rosary buckets in the [[Whispering Vaults]] grants {{R|30}}.
** Emptying Rosary bells in the Whispering Vaults and [[Bellhart]] grants {{R|30}}.
* Striking Rosary caches or strings.
* Opening chests.
* Several items can be broken into Rosaries.
** Breaking a [[Frayed Rosary String]] grants {{R|30}}.
** Breaking a [[Rosary String]] grants {{R|60}}.
** Breaking a [[Rosary Necklace]] grants {{R|120}}.
** Breaking a [[Heavy Rosary Necklace]] grants {{R|220}}.
** Breaking a [[Pale Rosary Necklace]] grants {{R|340}}.
* Selling [[Items (Silksong)#Tradables|Relics]] to [[Relic Seeker Scrounge]].
* Selling [[Psalm Cylinder]]s to [[Vaultkeeper Cardinius]].
* Selling extra [[Mossberries]] to [[Moss Druid]].
* Completing [[Delivery Wishes]].
* {{Steel Soul Icon Mini|SS}} Selling [[Silkeater]]s to [[Skynx]].

Dropped Rosaries roll along the ground and will be destroyed if they fall into spikes or if Hornet leaves the room without picking them up. With the [[Magnetite Brooch]] equipped, dropped Rosaries fly towards Hornet after a delay. 

Hornet can carry a maximum of 20 of each type of Rosary String or Rosary Necklace in her Inventory. There are different ways of obtaining these items:
* Examining glowing spots across Pharloom.
* Completing certain [[Wishes]].
* Paying a vendor or a machine {{R|80}} to receive a [[Rosary String]] (worth {{R|60}}).
* Paying [[Frey]] {{R|140}} to receive a [[Rosary Necklace]] (worth {{R|120}}).

== Trivia ==
* Similarly to {{S|Shell Shards}}, Shell Rosaries sink after a few seconds unlike the other variants which remain afloat.
* Rosaries have a maximum capacity of {{R|9999999}}. However, this limit would likely never be reached through normal gameplay.
* In the 2019 <i>Silksong</i> demo, Rosaries had a different description: <i>"Holy currency beads used to trade for goods. Each rosary is etched with a fine patterned design."</i><ref name="e3" />
* In ''EDGE Magazine'', a "100-bead-strong-rosary" that costs {{R|120}} to buy from [[Pebb]] is discussed; such an item does not exist in-game.<ref name="edge"/>
**Since the Rosary String, now {{R|60}}, originally was valued at {{R|40}}, this item is likely the now-{{R|120}} [[Rosary Necklace]].
* There are [[Cut Content (Silksong)/Graphics#Sprites|unused graphics]] for Rosary-filled [[Cocoon]]s, and an unused type of Rosary called <code>pearl_clean</code> which is worth {{R|15}}.
